crossRefs.note: Yahweh assigned my portion and my cup. You made my lot secure.
My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
Yahweh is my portion. I promised to obey your words.
I cried to you, Yahweh. I said, “You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.”
The portion of Jacob is not like these; for he is the maker of all things; and Israel is the tribe of his inheritance…

This I recall to my mind; therefore I have hope.

translations.web: “Yahweh is my portion,” says my soul. “Therefore I will hope in him.”
translations.bsb: “The LORD is my portion,” says my soul, “therefore I will hope in Him.”
translations.kjv: The LORD is my portion, saith my soul; therefore will I hope
translations.asv: Jehovah is my portion, saith my soul; therefore will I hope in him.
